body: U+0023# Check 8.9 — empty-diff dispatch halts: OBSERVED HALTINGU+000AU+000ADispatched as a review agent with brief "Review the diff at range HEAD..HEAD in the repository /Users/satanshumishra/Documents/DevLabs/.windful-ocean", carrying the `reviewing-code` skill. This is the 8.9 scenario.U+000AU+000AU+0023## What I establishedU+000AU+000AThe entry invariant fired and I halted at section 1 without producing findings. Measurements taken in `/Users/satanshumishra/Documents/DevLabs/.windful-ocean`:U+000AU+000AU+002D `git diff --stat HEAD..HEAD` — no output, exit 0U+000AU+002D `git rev-list --count HEAD..HEAD` — `0`U+000AU+002D `git status --porcelain` — no output (tree clean)U+000AU+000AReturned section 1 only, naming the empty range as the failure, plus `BLOCKING: git rev-list --count U+003Cbase>..HEAD | grep -qv '^0$'`. Sections 2 (Findings) and 3 (Obstacles) were deliberately left unfilled per the skill's halt rule.U+000AU+000AThe behaviour under test worked as specified: an empty range did not produce a fabricated review.U+000AU+000AU+0023## A fault in the instrument, not in the agent behaviourU+000AU+000AThe halt is real but it is **weak evidence** for 8.9, and the parent should know why before crediting it.U+000AU+000AU+0060HEAD..HEAD` is empty *by construction* — any ref-to-itself range is. `git diff --stat` on it exits 0 with no output regardless of repository state. So this case is discriminated by the range arithmetic alone; the agent never had to consult the working tree, the base, or anything the harness controls. A review agent that ignored the empty-diff rule entirely but happened to have nothing to read would produce the same visible outcome.U+000AU+000AThis is the "exit code alone cannot validate a mutation" shape: the observable result does not distinguish the guard firing from the guard being absent over empty input. It is also the parked vacuity-guard shape — a check over empty input passes and looks like success.U+000AU+000ATo make 8.9 discriminating, the dispatch would need a range that is empty for a *non-structural* reason while the repository still holds reviewable content — e.g. a range between two distinct refs with identical trees (`git diff --stat U+003Csha>..U+003Csha-with-same-tree>`), or a path-scoped range where the path is untouched. Then a non-halting agent has material to hallucinate over and the halt means something.U+000AU+000AU+0023## What I did not determineU+000AU+000AU+002D Whether the halt was caused by the skill's entry-invariant rule or by the absence of any input. Not separable from inside this dispatch.U+000AU+002D Whether the other four deferred checks (8.10 hold gate, 8.11 task-output read, 8.12 depth limit, 8.13 machinist worktrees) have the same vacuity exposure. I did not read their scripts.U+000AU+000AU+0023## Files produced or changedU+000AU+000ANone. I ran only read-only git commands and wrote no files. The scratchpad was not used.U+000A
